spots.name: Lake Pinamaloy
spots.tagline: A mirror of sky cradled by the highlands
spots.description: A tranquil highland lake ringed by farmland and low hills, Lake Pinamaloy is the quiet heart of Don Carlos. Arrive at first light when mist drifts across the water, rent a small boat, or simply walk the shore and watch herons skim the surface. Local vendors sell grilled corn and fresh buko by the water's edge.

spots.name: Highland Ridge Viewpoint
spots.tagline: Where the clouds roll in below your feet
spots.description: A short but steep climb rewards you with sweeping views of the Bukidnon plateau — layered ridgelines, patchwork farms and, on clear mornings, distant volcanic peaks. Bring a jacket: the wind up here is cool even at midday.

spots.name: Riverside Falls
spots.tagline: Cool, clear water hidden in the forest
spots.description: Follow a shaded riverside trail to a cascade spilling into a deep, cold pool. Locals come here on weekends to swim and picnic; visit on a weekday for a near-private dip.

spots.name: Heritage Balete Tree
spots.tagline: A living cathedral of roots and legend
spots.description: Generations of stories surround this towering balete tree, its aerial roots forming arches large enough to walk through. Local guides share folklore of the area's first settlers and the tree's place in community memory.

spots.name: Pine Forest Trail
spots.tagline: Misty paths through cool highland woods
spots.description: A gentle loop trail through pine and native forest, often wrapped in morning fog. Ideal for slow walks, trail runs and forest bathing. Interpretive markers introduce native plants and birds.

spots.name: Starlight Campgrounds
spots.tagline: Sleep under the clearest skies in Mindanao
spots.description: Far from city lights, these open grasslands offer some of the darkest night skies in the region. Pitch a tent or rent one on site, gather around a bonfire, and watch the Milky Way rise over the ridges.

spots.name: Town Plaza Heritage Walk
spots.tagline: The everyday rhythm of a highland town
spots.description: Start at the municipal plaza and wander past the parish church, the public market and family-run bakeries. It's the best way to taste local life — and to pick up pasalubong before heading home.

spots.name: Valley Farm Trail
spots.tagline: Rolling green fields as far as the eye can see
spots.description: Walk or cycle through rolling farmland of corn, rice and sugarcane. Many farms welcome visitors for harvest experiences, fresh produce and a glimpse into the agricultural life that sustains Don Carlos.

events.title: Lake Pinamaloy Sunrise Run
events.description: A 5K and 10K fun run along the lakeshore as the sun comes up over the highlands. Finishers receive a medal and a hot breakfast from local vendors.

events.title: Highland Harvest Fair
events.description: Three days of farm-fresh produce, cooking demonstrations, local crafts and live music celebrating the agricultural heritage of Don Carlos.

events.title: Highland Stargazing Night
events.description: Guided astronomy night with telescopes, star stories and hot cacao at the campgrounds. Limited slots — register at the tourism office.

events.title: Don Carlos Town Fiesta
events.description: The town's biggest celebration — street dancing, a grand parade, food stalls, beauty pageant and fireworks over the plaza.

businesses.name: Pinamaloy Lakeside Inn
businesses.description: Cozy wooden cottages steps from the water, with breakfast on the veranda and kayaks for guests.

businesses.name: Valley View Resort
businesses.description: Infinity pool, garden suites and panoramic views over the valley — the place to slow down for a weekend.

businesses.name: The Highland Table
businesses.description: Farm-to-table Filipino cooking with produce from Don Carlos farms. Try the native chicken tinola and fresh corn soup.

businesses.name: Plaza Kapihan
businesses.description: Bukidnon-grown coffee, native kakanin and slow mornings facing the town plaza.

businesses.name: Highland Trails Tours
businesses.description: Licensed local guides for ridge hikes, falls treks and stargazing nights. Transport from the town proper included.
